mutants.name: module-branch-removed
mutants.why: the module branch must emit '(module)' labels; removing it makes every caller emit 'file::name' so root-level module callers are mis-labelled and t13 catches it

mutants.name: module-discriminator-flipped
mutants.why: the discriminator must be '== module' not '!= module'; flipping it labels every non-module caller as '(module)' and t14 catches the wrong label on a function caller

mutants.name: verified-guard-removed
mutants.why: the import check guard must filter unverified edges; removing it counts all cross-file call edges and t6 asserts only the verified caller is counted

mutants.name: sample-slice-reduced
mutants.why: the sample slice must be [:3] not [:2]; reducing it silently drops the third distinct caller and t15 asserts len(sample) == 3 with four callers

mutants.name: sample-set-removed
mutants.why: the set() dedup must be applied before slicing; removing it keeps duplicates in the sample so a caller with two edges appears twice and t14 catches the duplicate
